fieldNotes.truckGate: Cross-dock RDC (DC #5641, 657K sq ft). Truck yard entrance off the access road at the SW corner; the office/parking front faces N Tracy Blvd, the truck side is fenced and gated.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Standard guarded RDC entry — booth at the SW truck-yard entrance. HD RDCs of this generation consistently run a staffed gate; the SW gate apron shows the checkpoint geometry.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved aprons on both long faces give substantial inside-the-gate queue room before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal aprons running the full length of both faces — 3+ trucks of stacking.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Generous paved width at the SW gate apron; room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dense regular dock-door rhythm with trailers backed in along both the long north and long south faces — well over 100 doors (cross-dock RDC).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock layout — receiving on one long face, shipping on the opposite face; two distinct dock banks.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer drop-yard rows along the north side and additional trailer parking on the south.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial/logistics district on the north side of Tracy CA; large warehouses and open/fallow parcels around it — judged Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated; exact lane count at the gate not fully resolved from imagery.
